visual.general_description: Grayscale axial CT image of the abdomen and pelvis with a large uniform mid-gray region around central bowel and the pelvic bones at the bottom.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale axial CT image of the lower abdomen and pelvis with the body outline and the curved scanner table at the bottom, and a dark reddish tint in the black margin at the upper corners. A large, fairly uniform mid-gray region fills most of the cavity on both sides. Black gas-filled bowel loops lie along the top (anterior) edge, with a bright rounded structure at the upper left next to a gas-filled loop. A heterogeneous central cluster of bowel and mesentery with darker fat and small bright dots sits in the middle. At the bottom, the bright white pelvic bones and the spine lie around the center with a few small round bright vessels near the spine, and soft tissue and fat of the back and buttocks lie below. A thin white cross marker is at the left of center. No printed text, arrows or measurement values are visible.
